statements.text: Paul Lawrence was named the fourth women's soccer head coach in program history in March 2023.

When Lawrence was named the head women's soccer coach at Knox College in January of 2014, the Prairie Fire had not had a winning season in 18 years, not qualified for the conference tournament since 1995, nor won a conference game since 201
